channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Chennai-based Anicut Capital to invest in 20 startups with ₹175-crore fund
item.description: This fund is set to focus on Pre-e to Series A investments across deep-tech, enterprise-tech, consumer, and financial services startups

item.title: BJP bids to stave off JSP, RJD challenge as campaigning ends for Bankipur byelection
item.description: Candidates make final push to secure the seat in Bihar vacated by BJP national president Nitin Nabin following his election to the Rajya Sabha in April

item.title: Ahead of proposed strike, Haryana Energy Minister Anil Vij says talks with employees underway
item.description: Referring to their second demand regarding smart meters, Mr. Vij said that no tenders have yet been floated for the project and that the proposal is still under process

item.title: State Highways expedites work on ₹24-crore high-level bridge across Then Pennar river in Tiruvannamalai
item.description: The new bridge will be funded under the Comprehensive Road Infrastructure Development Programme (CRIDP) 2024-25

item.title: 150 years of the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science
item.description: The IACS has cultivated a legacy of intellectual curiosity, scientific excellence, and national service that continues to inspire generations of researchers, Shekhar Mande writes

item.title: A.P. inks pact with AstraZeneca to set up Genomic Solutions Centre in Amaravati
item.description: The centre to use next-generation sequencing, AI, and genomic technologies to facilitate early cancer detection and recommend personalised treatment based on a patient's genetic profile; as part of project, AI-enabled X-ray systems to be installed in government hospitals to ensure proper diagnosis

item.title: Pleas in Supreme Court allege illegal detentions by Delhi and Bihar police
item.description: Volunteer who distributed food and water to protesters at Jantar Mantar and his friend allege that police seized their phones, blindfolded them and questioned them at an undisclosed location over the ‘source of funds’; law student held without arrest warrant still in Bihar police custody

item.title: CPI(M), PDP condemn killings by security forces in POK
item.description: Reports claim 21 people were killed and dozens injured in firing by security forces on supporters of the Joint Awami Action Committee in Rawalakot on July 27

item.title: Pen mightier than any weapon: Ex-MP Vijay Sankeshwar
item.description: Former member of Parliament and industrialist Vijay Sankeshwar said that journalists had the responsibility of shaping the future of the country, and they should throw light on building a prosperous ‘Bharat’

item.title: Edappally-Aroor elevated highway project in Kochi put on hold
item.description: Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nithin Gadkari informs Hibi Eden, MP, that the current priority is to widen the rest of the Thiruvananthapuram-Kasaragod NH 66

item.title: Relief camps shut in Kerala’s Ernakulam as rain situation eases
item.description: The eastern parts of Ernakulam district received only light spells of rain on Friday

item.title: DACL Fine Chem to set up ₹500 crore chemical unit in KSEZ
32 fall ill after eating snacks in Kakinada
Indian Army contingent to participate in Seychelles’ 50th Independence Day celebrations
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi to attend Golden Jubilee celebrations as Guest of Honour; Indian Army and Navy contingents to join ceremonial parade

item.title: Rajya Sabha MP moves Supreme Court against use of facial recognition technology at NEET protests
item.description: A.A. Rahim seeks the apex court’s intervention on ‘...the automated, algorithmic extraction and matching of the biometric identifiers of thousands of peaceful protesters, and the interlinking of such data with permanent national criminal databases’ in a ‘...complete legal vacuum’

item.title: Bengaluru is part of Mercedes-Benz’s 140-year global anniversary tour
item.description: The German luxury automotive brand marked its transcontinental tour, which will touch 140 places across 23 countries and five continents, with celebrations across its Bengaluru campuses

item.title: Biren Singh’s audio clip altered, says Centre; SC allows Manipur civil society group to access report
item.description: Petitioner-NGO says earlier tests had shown a 93% match linking the audio clips to the former Chief Minister; plea alleges the leader was involved in the ethnic violence in which over 250 people were killed

item.title: Woman auto driver, allegedly denied right to work, reinstated in Kerala’s Kochi
item.description: The 52-year-old, who was reportedly not allowed to work for over four months after her expulsion from the CITU, was reinstated after her plight caught public attention through media reports

item.title: Residents of old age home steal the scene at fashion show for senior citizens in Kerala’s Thrissur
item.description: Residents of Thrissur Government Old Age Home win four honours at ‘Niram 2026’, proving confidence and creativity only grow with the years

item.title: Volunteers extend support to Giri Pradakshina pilgrims
Latur municipal authorities visit Ambedkar memorial as part of study tour
Naidu directs comprehensive support for farmers in A.P. amid El Niño threat
item.description: Chief Minister tells officials to establish a dedicated El Niño Control Room for continuous monitoring and scientific advisories through Rythu Seva Kendras; says every cultivated crop must be covered under crop insurance, for which Collectors have to take responsibility

item.title: YSRCP will intensify agitation over Mega DSC 'irregularities', says Jagan
item.description: Unemployed youth and other people participated in large numbers in protest rallies across district headquarters, which reflects the growing anger among them, remarks the YSRCP chief CM

item.title: Dr. NTRUHS V-C announces strict penalties for exam malpractice
VMC seizes 640.9 kg of single-use plastic during surprise inspections
item.description: Authorities warn that the sale, storage, and use of single-use plastic is prohibited in the city, and violators will have their trade licences cancelled

item.title: YSRCP stages protests across State over DSC ‘irregularities', demands Lokesh's resignation
item.description: Party student and youth wing members take out rallies and hold demonstrations in Vijayawada, Nellore, Tirupati, Nandyal and other places alleging paper leaks, irregularities in Sports Quota appointments and denial of opportunities to deserving candidate; police stop a proposed rally in Narasannapeta

item.title: Kerala CPI(M)’s self-critical review document preludes an organisational rectification process in State unit starting in September 2026
item.description: Review of Left Democratic Front (LDF)’s Assembly election debacle in Kerala. CPI(M) notes that its messaging about transformational development did not resonate among the middle classes. The growing influence of caste- and religion-tinted identity politics causes an erosion of the party’s basic voters, namely ‘workers, agricultural workers and poor peasants’

item.title: Guntur police arrest six for ‘stealing’ 91 motor pump sets
item.description: They recover 85 pump sets, 18 kg of copper wire, two cars, and an autorickshaw allegedly used in the crimes

item.title: Former Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan says arrest attempt of student Aishe Ghosh is an assault on democratic rights
GRP head constable sentenced to 5 years RI in corruption case
Expedite Amaravati works without compromising on quality: Naidu
item.description: Chief Minister reviews 95 projects worth ₹50,999 crore, sets a minimum monthly progress target of 7.92%, and calls for integrated planning of Amaravati with Vijayawada and Guntur

item.title: Kerala PWD to begin project works only after land acquisition, says Minister
Kerala Police to launch joint action plan with banks to combat cyber frauds
item.description: The proposed coordination mechanism will enable the police to respond more effectively to emerging cyber threats, including rapidly evolving scams such as ‘digital arrest’ frauds

item.title: Public examinations amendment Bill does not address fundamental issues: AISEC
item.description: AISEC vice-president M. Shajarkhan says the proposed legislation focuses mainly on enhancing penalties and expediting investigation and trial, but it does not introduce clear preventive measures

item.title: Sharad Pawar puts an end to speculations on merger
item.description: Over the last few months, several leaders had said that it was the late NCP leader Ajit Pawar’s last wish to see both parties

item.title: Hearing on Gadkari's suit against deepfake posts deferred to August 5
item.description: The suit against Meta, X, Google and unknown persons alleges that the viral content has tarnished Union Minister Nitin Gadkari's reputation and personality rights

item.title: Kerala Cabinet subcommittee on PM SHRI scheme yet to finalise report, says Minister N. Samsudheen
item.description: Samsudheen says subcommittee chaired by him and comprising Minister for Higher Education Roji M. John, Minister for Tourism P.C. Vishnunadh and Minister for Excise M. Liju will meet one more time and submit report without delay

item.title: Kerala sanctions ₹41.5 crore for KSRTC's Priyadarshini scheme
item.description: The amount covers the period starting from June 15 to 30.

item.title: Punjabi University institutes ‘Principal Chhabil Das Yadgari Award’
Kerala government to install 60 km of solar fencing in Wayanad to alleviate human-wildlife conflict
item.description: The project will be implemented under the State government’s 100-day action programme; govt. has entrusted Wildlife Institute of India with conducting carrying capacity study of forests in Wayanad in view of large number of human settlements located close to forest areas

item.title: Demand for separate Haematology dept. at Kozhikode MCH still pending
item.description: At present, it is functioning as an extension of the General Medicine department

item.title: Rajnath Singh unveils Coast Guard reforms to boost gender equality
item.description: Another reform simplifies the process of granting ex-gratia compensation to the families of personnel reported missing at sea while on duty

item.title: 13 Indian sailors trapped amid attacks in Black Sea: Union
item.description: Repeated drone and missile attacks are being attempted in the immediate vicinity of the vessel and the crew is living under constant fear of a direct hit at any moment, FSUI said in a post on X

item.title: Restoration of Punyam Poonkavanam project in Sabarimala temple runs the risk of violating Kerala High Court order
item.description: Devaswom Bench of Kerala HC had in February, 2025 asked Travancore Devaswom Board and Kerala Police to issue an advisory to Sabarimala pilgrims that the project is not part of Police Bandobast Scheme from Mandalam-Makaravilakku festival season of 2023-24 and that its name cannot be used for any activity connected with Sabarimala

item.title: NSMC 2026 marks fourth edition, expands across South India
HYDRAA is a blackmailing tool for CM: KTR
item.description: He meets Union Minister, seeks clearance of railway projects, bats for IT spread in Tier-2 cities

item.title: Heavy rainfall forecast in 10 Telangana districts on July 29
Overnight showers drench Hyderabad on July 27, heavy rains lash several Telangana districts
item.description: The rains continued into Tuesday morning

item.title: Truck full of stones found parked at protest site ahead of July 20 march was in police custody: report
item.description: Delhi Police say claims alleging that the truck was deliberately deployed near Jantar Mantar or outside any political party office were “false and misleading”

item.title: Bar Councils must collect data on lawyers facing criminal records, says Madras High Court
item.description: Rising indicators of criminality in the Bar may taint the image of the bar as well as the justice delivery system, observes Justice D. Bharatha Chakravarthy

item.title: Inventory of Bescom-related obstructions on city’s footpaths to be prepared for clearance
VIT Chancellor Viswanathan calls on CM Vijay
Bengaluru: PSI under scanner after audio clip alleging bribe demand goes viral
Tamil Nadu earmarks ₹50 crore revolving fund for disaster preparedness: Minister
item.description: The Minister also announced the establishment of Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Institute at an estimated cost of ₹55 crore.

item.title: Study cites Soligas of Biligiri as an example against ‘fortress conservation approach’
item.description: New research article highlights the need to understand and recognise the importance of Adivasi people’s connections, knowledge and skills in forest management

item.title: Supreme Court to examine impact of data protection law on RTI, investigative journalism
item.description: The court said both the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and the RTI Act were central legislations with a need to harmonise them; it would examine if this restrictive or ‘cautionary approach’ to sharing data under the DPDP Act worked to repeal earlier transparency legislations

item.title: Meta ramps up censorship of protest, political reels
item.description: Instagram posts by political party accounts, Cockroach Janta Party representatives, and ordinary protesters have all been blocked in India; Meta is even barring content it is not legally required to remove

item.title: Conflict of interest in startup funding panel ‘unavoidable’, says Technology Development Board secretary
item.description: Government defends overlap between TDB investment committee members and companies backed under ₹1 lakh crore RDI Fund

item.title: India dismisses foreign concerns over FCRA Bill, says it is an internal matter
item.description: The response comes after U.S. Congressman Riley M. Moore said the Bill was a “clear attack against Christians”

item.title: Hyderabad’s new elevated corridor reshapes a neighbourhood, one shop at a time
item.description: As Paradise-Shamirpet elevated corridor takes shape, decades-old shops and neighbourhood landmarks along Lothkunta’s Rajiv Rahadari are disappearing, marking the end of a familiar streetscape even as the project promises to ease congestion on one of Secunderabad’s busiest traffic routes
